week1.title: Product Launch Strategy
week1.description: Your company is about to launch a revolutionary product. Define your go-to-market strategy.
week1.context: TechVenture Inc. has developed an innovative product after 18 months of R&D. The market is competitive, with three major players controlling 60% of market share. You have $150K allocated for the launch, but investor pressure is high for quick returns.

marketing.title: Marketing Budget Allocation
marketing.description: Allocate your marketing budget across channels

campaign.title: Creative Campaign Proposal
campaign.description: Submit your creative marketing campaign strategy (PDF)
campaign.rubric: Creativity (25%), Market fit (25%), Feasibility (25%), Brand alignment (25%)

pricing.title: Pricing Strategy
pricing.description: Choose your pricing approach for market entry

premium.label: Premium Pricing ($199) - Position as luxury/quality product

hiring.title: Initial Hiring Plan
hiring.description: How many new employees to hire for launch (Sales + Support)

week2.title: Crisis Management: Supply Chain Disruption
week2.description: A major supplier has failed. Navigate this crisis while maintaining operations.
week2.context: Week 2 brings unexpected challenges. Your primary component supplier has declared bankruptcy, disrupting 70% of your supply chain. Competitors are facing the same issue. Customer orders are piling up, and your reputation is at stake.

supplier.title: Supplier Strategy
supplier.description: Choose your approach to solving the supply chain crisis

premium.label: Emergency Premium Supplier (3x cost, immediate delivery)

communication.title: Crisis Communication Plan
communication.rubric: Transparency (30%), Stakeholder management (30%), Action plan (20%), Tone (20%)

retention.title: Customer Retention Budget
retention.description: Allocate budget for customer retention (discounts, expedited shipping)

overtime.title: Employee Overtime Authorization
overtime.description: Approve overtime hours to meet demand (hours per week per employee)

week3.title: Growth Strategy: Expansion or Optimization
week3.description: Your product has gained traction. Decide how to scale the business.
week3.context: Sales are growing steadily at 20% month-over-month. You have three options: expand to new markets, optimize current operations, or invest in R&D for next-gen products. Investor board meeting is next month - they expect a clear vision.

expansion.label: Market Expansion - Enter 3 new geographic markets

optimization.label: Operational Excellence - Optimize efficiency and margins

innovation.label: Innovation Focus - Invest heavily in R&D for Product 2.0

pitch.title: Investment Pitch Deck
pitch.description: Submit your strategic vision presentation for investors (PDF)
pitch.rubric: Vision clarity (25%), Financial projections (25%), Risk mitigation (25%), Market analysis (25%)

week4.title: Competitive Threat Response
week4.description: A major competitor launches a product directly targeting your market.
week4.context: Intel reveals that market leader GlobalTech has launched a competing product at 30% lower price. Their marketing budget is 5x yours. Early reviews are mixed but their brand recognition is strong. You must respond decisively to protect your market position.

response.title: Competitive Response Strategy
response.description: Choose how to respond to the competitive threat

pricewar.label: Price War - Match their pricing and compete head-on

differentiation.label: Differentiation - Emphasize quality and unique features

pivot.label: Pivot - Target different customer segment they ignore

analysis.title: Competitive Analysis Report
analysis.description: Submit detailed competitor analysis and response plan (PDF)
analysis.rubric: Competitive intelligence (30%), Strategic response (30%), Execution plan (20%), Risk assessment (20%)

marketing.title: Emergency Marketing Fund
marketing.description: Allocate emergency budget for counter-marketing campaign

week5.title: Future Vision: Exit Strategy or Scale
week5.description: You have received an acquisition offer. Decide the future of your company.
week5.context: Major corporation TechGlobal has offered to acquire TechVenture Inc. for $10M. Alternatively, venture capital firm wants to invest $5M for 30% equity to scale globally. Or you can continue bootstrapping with current trajectory. This decision will define your legacy.

future.title: Strategic Decision
future.description: Choose the future path for your company

acquisition.label: Accept Acquisition - $10M exit, team absorbed by TechGlobal

vcinvestment.label: Take VC Investment - Scale aggressively with $5M injection

bootstrap.label: Continue Bootstrapping - Maintain independence and organic growth

presentation.title: Board Presentation & Recommendation
presentation.description: Submit your strategic recommendation with detailed analysis (PDF)
presentation.rubric: Strategic vision (25%), Financial analysis (25%), Stakeholder impact (25%), Long-term planning (25%)

budget.title: 12-Month Budget Plan
budget.description: Project your budget for next year under chosen strategy

culture.title: Company Culture Investment
culture.description: Allocate budget for employee retention and culture
